task.title: Add a recovery path for tasks holding an unrecognized status
task.description:
A task whose status this build does not recognize is visible on both boards (since WB-01KZBT6J3R1YHG7Q2S6EDQ3JGJ) but unwritable: validateStateDocument normalizes the parent state before applying any operation pack, so every mutation — including one that would correct the status itself — exits 7 (corrupt-data). Verified end to end during the unknown-status board work: the board note deliberately states the limitation instead of offering an edit that would fail on save.

Provide a deliberate recovery mechanism, e.g. allowing a status-correcting update to proceed when the ONLY invalid field in the parent state is the status being replaced, or a dedicated 'workbook repair' flow that rewrites the status with an explicit operation. Whatever the shape, it must stay append-only (no ref rewriting) and refuse to silently normalize other corrupt fields.

This becomes routine, not exotic, once per-project custom status columns land and clones can disagree about the status vocabulary (WB-01KYQPKSGAMTB9TQZEV17RGY55) — coordinate the design with that work; a 'status unknown to this build' may then be valid rather than corrupt, which changes what recovery should mean.

---

**Re-scoped (2026-08-11, v0.5.0 design):** the routine wedge described above dissolves as a side effect of the custom-status-columns work (WB-01KYQPKSGAMTB9TQZEV17RGY55): vocabulary membership moves to the mutation boundary (exit 5) and replay/normalization applies only a structural token rule (exit 7), so a status-correcting `workbook update --status` on a task holding an unknown-but-well-formed status succeeds as an ordinary append-only operation. No repair verb.

This story now delivers the deliberate discovery and correction flow:
- `workbook status list` reports an `unresolved` block: statuses that resolve to no vocabulary entry through the rename/retirement chain, with task counts, task IDs, and the correcting command.
- `workbook list --status <value>` accepts a value outside the vocabulary (legitimate under a distributed vocabulary) and carries a warning in the envelope instead of refusing, so a typo does not silently return zero rows.
- Web: unknown-region cards become draggable OUT (the region still takes no drops); the region copy is rewritten to name the likely cause (a vocabulary this clone has not fetched) and the correction affordances. The detail form placeholder path already works.
- README documents the contract: vocabulary membership = mutation-boundary validation (exit 5); status shape = structural corruption (exit 7).

Acceptance regression pair: a task whose stored status is absent from the vocabulary accepts an UpdateMutation carrying a valid status (exit 0, one field.set appended); the same task with an additionally corrupt field still exits 7. Documented residue, deliberately unhandled: a stored status failing the structural kebab-token rule (unreachable via any Workbook-written document -- hand-edited or hostile refs only) remains unwritable; a repair verb is deferred until anyone ever hits it.
